_meta.note: License logistics data for the Assignment Compass. HAND-MAINTAINED, on purpose: David chairs the USRC Legislative Affairs Committee and keeps RCIC status current here as states enact. Compact membership verified against compact commission sources 2026-08-05. Fees and processing times are APPROXIMATE planning numbers, not quotes; the tool says 'verify with the board' and means it. Emitted to /assets/data/derived/licensure.json at build.

compact.name: Nurse Licensure Compact
compact.how: one multistate license, issued by your primary state of residence

CA.note: CA BRN endorsement is notoriously slow. Start the paperwork the day you start considering the contract.

compact.name: Respiratory Care Interstate Compact
compact.how: compact privileges on your home-state license, once live
compact.statusLine: The RCIC Commission formed in April 2026 after the seventh and eighth states enacted; ten states are in as of August 2026 and roughly twenty more had bills this year. Privileges are NOT being issued yet. Realistic go-live is 2027 or later.

CA.note: CA RCB endorsement. Plan the timeline into the contract start date.

UT.note: DOPL endorsement is one of the faster ones.

compact.name: PT Compact
compact.how: purchased compact privileges per state, usually same-week

compact.name: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact
compact.how: expedited FULL license via letter of qualification, ~$700 service fee plus state fees

notes.HI: IMLC member but cannot serve as your state of principal license
notes.VT: IMLC member but cannot serve as your state of principal license

CA.note: California is not in the IMLC and its board moves at its own pace.

compact.name: Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact
compact.how: telepsychology authority plus up to 30 days per year in person; permanent in-person practice still needs the state license

other.label: Imaging / other allied
other.note: No licensure compact exists for imaging or most allied fields yet. ARRT certification is national; the STATE license is not, and a handful of states do not license imaging at all. Check the destination state board directly.
